Project-excluded scope and canonical provenance are program-enforced. After the initial compilation, call audit_stage2_candidate_coverage and review every returned predicate with submit_stage2_candidate_decision_batch. Supply exactly one structured activation, independent-violation, duplicate, action, and reason decision for every pending source node. The program binds canonical text and registers retained decisions. After the final decision batch, call the audit again. Seal only when both new_candidate_count and pending_structured_decision_count are zero. The audit is a completeness check, not an answer list or required output count. Complete all six regions and seal registration. THIS TEST MUST STOP IMMEDIATELY AFTER Stage 2 is sealed; no Stage 3 call is permitted.
